mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.2% triggers a preemptive S&P 500 forward return anticipation as investors price in higher future rates.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.2% in the current month
failure_condition: Over a 60-day window, 20-day forward returns do not deviate significantly from zero when inflation is above 0.2% (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS labor cost index exceeding 0.5% is associated with higher S&P 500 forward returns due to expectations of wage growth supporting corporate profits.
failure_condition: In 20-day windows where PAYEMS rises >0.5%, forward returns are not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both HOUST (industrial production) and RSAFS (retail sales) below their 2007-11-15 pre-crisis medians predicts negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns as demand softens.
candidate_trigger: both HOUST < 1191 and RSAFS < 367322 at decision date
failure_condition: Over 60 days, the joint signal is triggered >10% of the time but produces no statistically significant negative forward returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO supply index for three consecutive months predicts a positive S&P 500 60-day forward return as market anticipates production softness and potential cost pressures.
failure_condition: No significant positive 60-day forward returns when INDPRO declines for 3 months and other macro variables are neutral (multivariate F-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 4.8% for two consecutive months, the S&P 500 shows a positive 20-day forward return as higher rates are priced in early.
failure_condition: Over 100 such triggers, no more than 30% produce positive 20-day forward returns (binomial test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE decline below 4.0% signals weaker labor market expectations and is associated with negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns as investors anticipate slower wage growth.
failure_condition: In regimes where UNRATE <4.0% for 2 months, 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly increases in GDPC1 (GDP) and HOUST (industrial production) above their 2007-11-15 medians predict a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return as demand recovers rapidly.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 11630.7 AND HOUST > 1191 at decision date
failure_condition: Over 100 such triggers, 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When both INDPRO and GDPC1 show a double-dip in consecutive months (down then up from previous month), the S&P 500 20-day forward return is negative as uncertainty about supply dynamics discourages risk appetite.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO down then up AND GDPC1 down then up in the same window
failure_condition: Over 50 such double-dip events, no more than 20% produce negative 20-day forward returns (binomial test p > 0.05).
